title: Why You Should NEVER Drive Without a License
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 8th, 2023. Officers conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle that was going way over the speed limit, when the officer approached him and asked him for his license, he said he did not have one. The officer asked him to step out of the car and he did not want to comply, forcing the officers to physically pull him out of the car. It also came to the officers knowledge that the man had multiple warrants that he seemed to be unaware of. When the officers also did a search on his car, they found pink cocaine in his possession. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
